split_policy.primary_axis: retired surface disposition before fixture phase, diagnostic stage, report row, or provenance label
split_policy.positive_rule: retired old-mode, gate, retired route, compatibility, migration, unsupported-feature, typed runtime-dispatch projection, and evidence-log surfaces never define positive behavior truth
split_policy.canonical_rejection_rule: retired surfaces with checked-in fixture paths are canonical rejection or strict-error evidence owned by the phase that produces the diagnostic
split_policy.provenance_rule: migration-lane, evidence-log, audit-only, generated-output-only, and absent-support surfaces remain provenance-only unless a canonical rejection or strict-error fixture is added
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: old-mode, gate, retired route, compatibility, migration, evidence-log, unsupported, and typed runtime-dispatch projection claims are canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
